# Hooks

<!-- Generated by `npm run docs` from `src/lib/hooks.mts`; edit the source, not this page. -->

A hook runs at a fixed point of a session, such as before a tool call or when an agent stops. Each hook name starts with its kind, and the hooks below are grouped by kind.

## Guards

A guard denies a tool call or bounces a turn.

### guard.scope

Denies writes to kernel-owned files (`work/*/state.yaml`, `phases/`, `verdicts.jsonl`, `comments.jsonl`, `waivers.jsonl`, the tester's `test/` and `test.md`, `.picket/state/` except `branching.yaml`); denies an Edit on a file this transcript never read.

**Runs on:** PreToolUse, for `Write|Edit`

### guard.comments

Denies an edit that adds a comment line to a code file, doc comments included, unless `picket comment` recorded the user's approval for that path and text on an open or blocked item.

**Runs on:** PreToolUse, for `Write|Edit`

### guard.silenced

Denies an edit that adds a silenced check (a suppression, a skipped or focused test, a weaker coverage or warning threshold), unless `picket waive` recorded the user's approval for that path and line on an open or blocked item.

**Runs on:** PreToolUse, for `Write|Edit`

### guard.bash

The command evaluator: read-only commands allowed, destructive roots denied, compound and redirected commands prompt; PowerShell is only ever denied or passed on; lead-only verbs and agent shell writes to code are denied; `PICKET_ESCALATE` asks.

**Runs on:** PreToolUse, for `Bash|PowerShell`

### guard.blackbox

For the tester only, denies a Read of a file the item under test owns (plan paths, block files, fix files, its worktrees, `work/<id>/` outside `work/<id>/test/`) and a Grep that reaches one; a send naming no work item denies every Read and Grep.

**Runs on:** PreToolUse, for `Read|Grep`

### guard.block

A turn with a contract heading must end with an exact verdict token and stay within 40 lines; a developer PHASE DONE needs a Conventional Commits Commit: line.

**Runs on:** Stop, SubagentStop

## Injects

An inject adds context when a session or an agent starts.

### inject.state

Open work items with their next action, plus the host folder's `MEMORY.md` cut at the last whole entry within 6,000 characters; once per running version, when the config's `picket_version` is missing or older, a message asking the user to run `picket init` (recorded in `.picket/state/update-notice.json`).

**Runs on:** SessionStart

### inject.rules

The five rules in `rules/`, joined, for the lead and every agent.

**Runs on:** SessionStart, SubagentStart

### inject.extensions

Each enabled extension's rules and its additions for the lead or the starting agent's role, in config order, within 10,000 characters; one line per refused extension.

**Runs on:** SessionStart, SubagentStart

### inject.consulting

One line suggesting `picket:consulting` when a user prompt reads as a direction or stress-test question; silent on gate replies, short prompts and prompts naming a `picket:` skill.

**Runs on:** UserPromptSubmit

## Lints

A lint feeds text back to the model.

### lint.schema

Order and design artifacts: frontmatter, phase headings, decision ids, caps, placeholders, revision protocol against git HEAD; reports: kind, confidence, one marker per finding, finding and summary caps, placeholders.

**Runs on:** PostToolUse, for `Write|Edit`

### lint.glossary

Warns, never blocks, when a write leaves the host folder's `MEMORY.md` past the 6,000 characters `inject.state` injects.

**Runs on:** PostToolUse, for `Write|Edit`

## Monitors

A monitor feeds text back to the model.

### monitor.context

The stall detector: six look-around calls with no action get one line of context.

**Runs on:** PostToolUse, for `Read|Grep|Glob|WebFetch|WebSearch`

## Observers

An observer records what happened.

### observe.drive

Appends drive or inspect rows to `.picket/state/drive-log.jsonl` with the current work item and its phase; `picket verify` reads the rows.

**Runs on:** PostToolUse, PostToolUseFailure, for `Bash|PowerShell`

## Emitters

An emitter records what happened.

### emit.statusline

Copies the plugin's self-contained `statusline.mjs` into the project's `.picket/state/` when the project holds a Picket config, and into `CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA`, each when its copy is missing or differs, so each `statusLine` command keeps one path across plugin updates.

**Runs on:** SessionStart

### emit.ledger

One v2 ledger row per turn (`bench/schema/ledger-v2.schema.json`).

**Runs on:** Stop, SubagentStop

## Routers

A router applies a verdict.

### route.verdict

Applies the verdict to the work item with the kernel and hands back `picket next` as context.

**Runs on:** Stop, SubagentStop

## Notifiers

A notifier tells the user.

### notify.user

An OS notification in a detached process (a Windows toast through powershell.exe, osascript, notify-send); `PICKET_NOTIFY=off` skips it.

**Runs on:** Notification, for `permission_prompt|idle_prompt`

## Test environment

An env hook looks after the test-environment stacks a session started.

### env.stacks

At session end (not `clear` or `resume`), a detached `compose stop` for each test-environment stack the session started; at startup, stops stacks whose session is gone and names stacks whose item is done or abandoned; engines outside docker, podman and the fixture fake are skipped.

**Runs on:** SessionStart, SessionEnd
